name: Research Starter
description: An analysis that says what is in the first .csv in data/ and draws a chart of it -- press Run Analysis -- and a place for the question, the notes and what you found.
_matplotlibrc_note: The house chart style. matplotlib reads a matplotlibrc from the working directory and a project runs from its own directory, so every chart picks it up with no import and no setup call -- deterministic rather than dependent on the model writing one right line. It is a shipped file like the others, which means it is the child's to change.
_directories_note: data/ and notes/ are where a research project puts things it collects. The project already has a top-level data/ directory for imported datasets; these sit beside the analysis so a child can keep working notes next to the code that reads them.
